media.alt: Aga Khan University Hospital again brings health awareness programme to Dubai

content.text: A health awareness programme, 'Signs, Symptoms and Care' will be organized by Aga Khan University Hospital, Karachi (AKUH) to increases awareness for early diagnosis and timely treatment of health problems at the Sheraton Deira Hotel, Dubai on October 27, 2002 from 6:00 P.M. to 7:30 P.M.

AKUH is the principal teaching site of Aga Khan University (AKU), Karachi, which is the first private international university in Pakistan. The University occupies a pivotal place within Aga Khan Development Network, a private international development agency.

"Low Back Pain" and "Osteoporosis" are the titles of the presentations. The speakers are Dr. Riaz Hussain Lakdawala, Assistant Professor of Orthopaedic Surgery and Dr. Kamran Hameed, Associate Professor in the Department of Medicine at the AKUH.

Dr. Riaz Hussain Lakdawala did his FCPS (Orthopaedic Surgery) in 1993 from College of Physicians and Surgeons Pakistan. He did his training in orthopaedic surgery from Aga Khan University Hospital, Karachi. He has special interest in spine surgery. He was awarded faculty development awards for fellowships at Singapore and Turkey. He has spoken at a number of national and international seminars on low back pain

Dr. Kamran Hameed did his FCPS (Medicine) in 1992 from College of Physicians and Surgeons Pakistan. Dr. Hameed is Associate Professor in the Department of Medicine at Aga Khan University, Karachi. He has over 10 years experience in Rheumatology. He was awarded faculty development award for his training in the United Kingdom. He has published a number of articles in leading national and international medical journals.
In the lecture Dr. Riaz Hussain Lakdawala will discuss about the causes of back pain, when to seek professional help and what doctors can do. Dr. Kamran Hameed will discuss about osteoporosis.
The programme will include a question answer session in which participants would be encouraged to ask questions.
